items.title: Meta's US bond sale drew $58B in orders. Now it's tapping Europe.
items.summary: Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski joins The 8:30's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian to discuss Meta (META) completing a $15 billion US deal that drew about $58 billion in orders and is also launching a euro bond sale across six tranches.

items.title: Meta Has a Capex Guardrail That Few Talk About
items.summary: Meta is pouring well over $100B into AI, absorbing a massive legal charge, and watching its stock slide. One overlooked commitment from management gives this investor the nerve to keep buying while others fixate on the spending.

items.title: Anthropic Just Paid a News Publisher for the First Time, and It Was AP
items.summary: For years, Anthropic bet that fair use covered its training needs while rivals wrote checks. Then Election Night changed the pitch. Is this a one-off for an IPO-bound AI lab, or the start of a bill publishers like News Corp and the Times have been waiting on?

items.title: AMD CEO Su on earnings outlook, new Starbucks holiday menu, and Hilton CEO on hotel demand
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi tackles the biggest news of the market day, including AMD's (AMD) earnings outlook topping estimates as chip demand soars, what the blue wave in Congress means for a market rally, and how Starbucks (SBUX) plans its business around the holiday season with new products. 

Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Hilton (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta to discuss AI's impact on the hospitality industry.

items.title: Data Center Construction Starts Lag 6 Months Behind, Report Says
items.summary: Data center construction starts are slowing, a report from GlobalData finds. Here's why.

items.title: Dan Ives Sees Cash Flow Rebound In MSFT, META, GOOGL, AMZN: Says AI Bubble Fears Thrown Out The Window
items.summary: Ives expects debt and equity financing, including at-the-market stock offerings, to decline by about 25% over the next year.

items.title: Meta's AI Buildout Runs Into a Political Problem
items.summary: Election results are turning local AI infrastructure resistance into a real bottleneck.

items.title: Meta exec says midterm results makes new data centers challenging: WSJ
items.summary: Interactive Brokers Chief Strategist Steve Sosnick joins Pras Subramanian and Brooke DiPalma on The 8:30 to discuss Meta (META) President Dina Powell's view that building new data centers will be a challenge after the Democratic midterm election wins, and whether political backlash will actually halt future builds or push them overseas.
